title: C# Methods Pro
description: Advanced method features: named arguments and default parameters.
example:
static void MyMethod(string country = "Norway") { ... }
MyMethod(child1: "Liam", child2: "Jenny");

challenges.title: Default Parameter
challenges.exercise: Create 'Show(string msg = "Hello")' that prints 'msg'. Call Show() with no args.
challenges.solution:
static void Show(string msg = "Hello") { Console.WriteLine(msg); }
static void Main() { Show(); }

challenges.title: Named Arguments
challenges.exercise: Create 'Check(int x, int y)'. Call it using named arguments 'y: 2, x: 1'. Print 'Done'.
